sentences.text: The learned Additional Public Prosecutor (Puducherry) on instructions, submitted that as directed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, the complaint lodged by the petitioner was registered in crime No.75/2024 for the offences under Sections 403, 506(II), 379, 420 and 34 IPC and during the course of investigation, the 3rd respondent has examined 8 witnesses so far and investigation is about to complete.
At this stage, the transfer of investigation would affect the investigation which was already done by the 3rd respondent and also, no purpose would be served.
3. In such view of the matter, the 3rd respondent is directed to complete the investigation and file a final report, within a period of 12 weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
With the above direction, this criminal original petition is disposed of.
